source_note: Original community practice path. Each round is a separate attempt. Content is an AI-assisted preview awaiting practitioner review and calibration; this is not an employer process or a hiring-readiness certification.
name: First Job Foundations
blurb: Build a truthful introduction, explain a contribution from any setting, and practice a written screening answer. No previous paid work is required.

rounds.title: Your First Job: Introduce Your Strengths
rounds.focus: Build an introduction and support it with everyday experience, even before your first paid job.

rounds.title: Tell a Clear Story About Your Contribution
rounds.focus: Practice behavioral answers using truthful actions, outcomes, and reflection instead of memorized formulas.

rounds.title: Answer a Written Screening Question
rounds.focus: Practice clear written reasoning and a realistic plan for an asynchronous screening question.
